$comment: Permission to work a roadmap phase AHEAD of the first phase that is still open.
This file is the exemption mechanism precisely BECAUSE it is committed. A session that
wants to skip ahead cannot do it with a session-local flag or an environment variable -
it has to write an entry here, name an approver, give a reason of real length, and put
that in a commit where a reviewer sees it. The escape hatch is not closed; it is made
loud. Silent skipping is what actually happened, and silence is the part being removed.
Shape, keyed by phase number as a string:
"reason": "<at least 60 characters saying why this cannot wait for the open phase>",
"expires_at_epoch": 1770000000        // optional; past epoch = no longer valid
Empty is the correct default state. An empty exemptions object means: work the first
open phase, or declare 'meta' for repository governance and tooling.

2.reason: Phase 1 cannot be finished by a Builder. Two of its three Definition-of-Done rows are held open by the Owner's production gate, and the third independent audit (apps/desktop/AUDIT/2026-08-14-zero-trust-audit-e0dd969.md) READ all three refusals at main e0dd969 and confirmed every one of them CLOSED: governed_verification_unconfigured() returns Some(...) with no branch (commands.rs:1161-1164), connect_broker is #[cfg(target_os = "linux")] (governed_turn.rs:225-232), and build_governed_executor returns fail_closed() unless $BROPS_BROKER_CONFIG names a TCB-root-signed deployment config, which nothing in the shipped app sets (broker/src/main.rs:266-280). The rows are open BECAUSE the gate is shut on purpose, not because code is missing - see the roadmap's own text on both rows, and PR #98 which established that they reduce to one fact. They close when an independent audit passes and the Owner approves, in that order, and no change this Builder can make advances either. Phase 1's only unchecked TASK, the standing docs row, is done and claimed as T-018. Phase 2's eleven boxes are cockpit surfaces - approvals, decisions, security, notifications - that mirror engine state and decide nothing; the engine already serves brops.governance-read.v1, so none of them is behind the production gate. Owner decision taken 2026-08-15: build Phase 2 now and re-audit the whole body of work at the end rather than per-phase. NO expires_at_epoch is set deliberately: the condition that ends this exemption is Phase 1's gate opening, which has no date, and inventing one would be a fabricated fact in a file whose entire purpose is that skipping ahead is loud and honest.

3.reason: Same condition as the Phase 2 exemption, one phase further on, plus a second one that is now also true: Phase 2 has nothing left for a Builder either. Phase 1's two open Definition-of-Done rows are held by the Owner's production gate and the roadmap says so in its own words - 'No Builder change closes either row; an independent audit passing and the Owner approving does.' Phase 2 closed at 8 of 11 boxes on 2026-08-15 after the Owner delegated both remaining decisions; the three still open are one fact, the approval-REQUEST path across the wall, which is tracked as T-021 and deliberately sequenced BEHIND the standing audit because building it now would add an input to the engine's trust boundary while the independent verdict is RED. So with Phase 1 and Phase 2 both blocked on the same gate, the first phase with buildable work is 3. Phase 3 is cockpit-only - app shell, routing, home/chat/settings, the design-token stylesheet - and touches no gate: the governed chat path it wires was already built fail-closed in Phase 1 and stays that way, rendering Blocked rather than a message when no verified receipt exists. Owner instruction of 2026-08-15, verbatim in intent: go to Phase 3, do not stop until it is done, and do not stop on a gate that is not real. The verification-first discipline from Phase 2 (T-019) applies here too and has already paid: checking the code before building found two live defects nothing could see - a spacing token referenced and never declared, so two empty states shipped with no padding, and a command palette with no dialog role, no focus trap and no focus restoration. NO expires_at_epoch, for the same reason as the Phase 2 entry: the condition that ends this is the production gate opening, which has no date, and inventing one would put a fabricated fact in the file whose whole purpose is that skipping ahead is loud and honest.
